title: VTG PLAYBOY Magazine June 1989 - Kimberley Conrad - Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Playboy magazine from June 1989 featuring Kimberley Conrad on the cover. This issue is complete with the centerfold and includes illustrated content catering to a men's interest audience. With contributions from Hugh Hefner and a focus on photography, art, and modeling, this magazine offers a glimpse into the popular culture and entertainment of the late 1980s. A sought-after collectible for fans of nostalgic magazines and Playboy memorabilia.
